377 static void *DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolAlloc(MemPoolObj *pool,
378  uint32_t size,
379  uint8_t align)
380 {
381  void *retAddr = NULL;
382  uintptr_t addr;
383 
384  addr = CSL_MEM_ALIGN(pool->currAddr, align);
385  if ((addr + size) <= ((uintptr_t)pool->cfg.addr + pool->cfg.size))
386  {
387  retAddr = (void *)addr;
388  pool->currAddr = addr + size;
389  pool->maxCurrAddr = CSL_MAX(pool->currAddr, pool->maxCurrAddr);
390  }
391 
392  return(retAddr);
393 }

462 void _DPC_Objdet_Assert(DPM_Handle handle, int32_t expression,
463  const char *file, int32_t line)
464 {
465  DPM_DPCAssert fault;
466 
467  if (expression == 0)
468  {
469  fault.lineNum = (uint32_t)line;
470  fault.arg0 = 0U;
471  fault.arg1 = 0U;
472  (void)strncpy (fault.fileName, file, (DPM_MAX_FILE_NAME_LEN-1));
473 
474  /* Report the fault to the DPM entities */
475  (void)DPM_ioctl (handle,
476  DPM_CMD_DPC_ASSERT,
477  (void*)&fault,
478  sizeof(DPM_DPCAssert));
479  }
480 }

497 static void DPC_ObjectDetection_frameStart (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
498 {
499  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
500 
501 #ifdef POWER_MEAS
502  (void)DPC_ObjectDetection_HwaDspUngate(handle);
503 #endif
504 
505  objDetObj->stats.frameStartTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
506 
507  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Frame Start, frameIndx = %d, subFrameIndx = %d\n",
508  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter, objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
509 
510  /* Check if previous frame (sub-frame) processing has completed */
511  DPC_Objdet_Assert(objDetObj->dpmHandle, (int32_t)(objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken == 0));
512  objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken++;
513 
514  /* Increment interrupt counter for debugging and reporting purpose */
515  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == 0U)
516  {
517  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter++;
518  }
519 
520  /* Notify the DPM Module that the DPC is ready for execution */
521  DebugP_assert (DPM_notifyExecute (objDetObj->dpmHandle, handle) == 0);
522  return;
523 }

543 static void DPC_ObjDet_quadFit(float *x, float*y, float *xv, float *yv)
544 {
545  float a, b, c, denom;
546  float x0 = x[0];
547  float x1 = x[1];
548  float x2 = x[2];
549  float y0 = y[0];
550  float y1 = y[1];
551  float y2 = y[2];
552 
553  denom = (x0 - x1)*(x0 - x2)*(x1 - x2);
554  a = (x2 * (y1 - y0) + x1 * (y0 - y2) + x0 * (y2 - y1)) / denom;
555  b = (x2*x2 * (y0 - y1) + x1*x1 * (y2 - y0) + x0*x0 * (y1 - y2)) / denom;
556  c = (x1 * x2 * (x1 - x2) * y0 + x2 * x0 * (x2 - x0) * y1 + x0 * x1 * (x0 - x1) * y2) / denom;
557 
558  *xv = -b/(2.0F*a);
559  *yv = c - b*b/(4.0F*a);
560 }

579 static void DPC_ObjDet_rangeBiasRxChPhaseMeasure
580 (
581  DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg,
582  float targetDistance,
583  float searchWinSize,
584  uint16_t *detMatrix,
585  uint32_t *symbolMatrix,
586  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *compRxChanCfg
587 )
588 {
589  cmplx16ImRe_t rxSym[SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL];
590  cmplx16ImRe_t *tempPtr;
591  float sumSqr;
592  float xMagSq[SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL];
593  int32_t iMax;
594  float xMagSqMin;
595  float scal;
596  float truePosition;
597  int32_t truePositionIndex;
598  float y[3];
599  float x[3];
600  int32_t halfWinSize ;
601  float estPeakPos;
602  float estPeakVal;
603  int32_t i;
604  uint32_t ind;
605  uint32_t txIdx, rxIdx;
606  float temp_f;
607 
608  uint32_t numRxAntennas = staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
609  uint32_t numTxAntennas = staticCfg->numTxAntennas;
610  uint32_t numRangeBins = staticCfg->numRangeBins;
611  uint32_t numDopplerChirps = staticCfg->numDopplerChirps;
612  uint32_t numSymPerTxAnt = numDopplerChirps * numRxAntennas * numRangeBins;
613  uint32_t symbolMatrixIndx;
614 
615  uint16_t maxVal = 0;
616 
617  truePosition = targetDistance / staticCfg->rangeStep;
618  temp_f = truePosition + 0.5;
619  truePositionIndex = (int32_t) (temp_f);
620 
621  temp_f = 0.5 * searchWinSize / staticCfg->rangeStep + 0.5;
622  halfWinSize = (int32_t) (temp_f);
623 
624  /**** Range calibration ****/
625  iMax = truePositionIndex;
626  for (i = truePositionIndex - halfWinSize; i <= truePositionIndex + halfWinSize; i++)
627  {
628  if (detMatrix[(uint32_t)i * (uint32_t)staticCfg->numDopplerBins] > maxVal)
629  {
630  maxVal = detMatrix[(uint32_t)i * (uint32_t)staticCfg->numDopplerBins];
631  iMax = i;
632  }
633  }
634 
635  /* Fine estimate of the peak position using quadratic fit */
636  ind = 0;
637  for (i = iMax-1; i <= iMax+1; i++)
638  {
639  sumSqr = 0.0F;
640  for (txIdx=0; txIdx < numTxAntennas; txIdx++)
641  {
642  for (rxIdx=0; rxIdx < numRxAntennas; rxIdx++)
643  {
644  symbolMatrixIndx = txIdx * numSymPerTxAnt + rxIdx * numRangeBins + (uint32_t)i;
645  tempPtr = (cmplx16ImRe_t *) &symbolMatrix[symbolMatrixIndx];
646  sumSqr += (float) tempPtr->real * (float) tempPtr->real +
647  (float) tempPtr->imag * (float) tempPtr->imag;
648  }
649  }
650 #ifdef SUBSYS_DSS
651  y[ind] = sqrtsp(sumSqr);
652 #else
653  y[ind] = sqrt(sumSqr);
654 #endif
655  x[ind] = (float)i;
656  ind++;
657  }
658  DPC_ObjDet_quadFit(x, y, &estPeakPos, &estPeakVal);
659  compRxChanCfg->rangeBias = (estPeakPos - truePosition) * staticCfg->rangeStep;
660 
661  /*** Calculate Rx channel phase/gain compensation coefficients ***/
662  for (txIdx = 0; txIdx < numTxAntennas; txIdx++)
663  {
664  for (rxIdx = 0; rxIdx < numRxAntennas; rxIdx++)
665  {
666  ind = txIdx * numRxAntennas + rxIdx;
667  xMagSq[ind] = (float) rxSym[ind].real * (float) rxSym[ind].real +
668  (float) rxSym[ind].imag * (float) rxSym[ind].imag;
669  }
670  }
671  xMagSqMin = xMagSq[0];
672  for (ind = 1; ind < staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas; ind++)
673  {
674  if (xMagSq[ind] < xMagSqMin)
675  {
676  xMagSqMin = xMagSq[ind];
677  }
678  }
679 
680  for (txIdx=0; txIdx < staticCfg->numTxAntennas; txIdx++)
681  {
682  for (rxIdx=0; rxIdx < numRxAntennas; rxIdx++)
683  {
684  int32_t temp;
685  ind = txIdx * numRxAntennas + rxIdx;
686  scal = 32768.F/ xMagSq[ind] * (float)sqrt(xMagSqMin);
687 
688  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(scal * (float)rxSym[ind].real);
689  temp = (int32_t) temp_f;
690  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
691  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[staticCfg->txAntOrder[txIdx] * numRxAntennas +
692  rxIdx].real = (int16_t) (temp);
693 
694  temp_f = MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(-scal * (float)rxSym[ind].imag);
695  temp = (int32_t) temp_f;
696  MATHUTILS_SATURATE16(temp);
697  compRxChanCfg->rxChPhaseComp[staticCfg->txAntOrder[txIdx] * numRxAntennas
698  + rxIdx].imag = (int16_t) (temp);
699  }
700  }
701 }

774  winGenLen = (uint32_t)numDopplerChirps;
775 #endif
776  return(winGenLen);
777 }

791 static uint32_t DPC_ObjDet_GenDopplerWindow(DPU_DopplerProcHWA_Config *cfg)
792 {
793  uint32_t winType;
794 
795  /* For too small window, force rectangular window to avoid loss of information
796  * due to small window values (e.g. hanning has first and last coefficients 0) */
797  if (cfg->staticCfg.numDopplerChirps <= 4U)
798  {
799  winType = MATHUTILS_WIN_RECT;
800  }
801  else
802  {
803  winType = DPC_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_FFT_WINDOW_TYPE;
804  }
805 
806  mathUtils_genWindow((uint32_t *)cfg->hwRes.hwaCfg.window,
807  cfg->staticCfg.numDopplerChirps,
808  DPC_ObjDet_GetDopplerWinGenLen(cfg),
809  winType,
810  DPC_OBJDET_QFORMAT_DOPPLER_FFT);
811 
812  return(winType);
813 }

829 static void DPC_ObjDet_GetRxChPhaseComp(DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg,
830  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *inpCfg,
831  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *outCfg)
832 {
833  uint32_t tx, rx, numTxAnt, numRxAnt;
834  uint8_t *txAntOrder, *rxAntOrder;
835  cmplx16ImRe_t one;
836 
837  one.imag = 0;
838  one.real = 0x7fff;
839 
840  numTxAnt = staticCfg->numTxAntennas;
841  numRxAnt = staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
842  txAntOrder = staticCfg->txAntOrder;
843  rxAntOrder = staticCfg->rxAntOrder;
844  outCfg->rangeBias = inpCfg->rangeBias;
845 
846  for(tx = 0; tx < numTxAnt; tx++)
847  {
848  for(rx = 0; rx < numRxAnt; rx++)
849  {
850  if (staticCfg->isValidProfileHasOneTxPerChirp == 1U)
851  {
852  /* AOP ant: it will always come here
853  * STD ant: it will come here for MIMO cases
854  */
855  outCfg->rxChPhaseComp[tx * numRxAnt + rx] =
856  inpCfg->rxChPhaseComp[txAntOrder[tx] * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL +
857  rxAntOrder[rx]];
858  }
859  else
860  {
861  outCfg->rxChPhaseComp[tx * numRxAnt + rx] = one;
862  }
863  }
864  }
865 }

903 static int32_t DPC_ObjDet_elevFFTCfg
904 (
905  DPU_AoAProcHWA_StaticConfig *DPParams
906 )
907 {
908  int32_t retVal = 0;
909  uint32_t zeroMask = DPParams->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev;
910  uint8_t numElemVirtualAntELev = mathUtils_ceilLog2(DPParams->zeroInsrtMaskCfg.zeroInsrtMaskElev);
911  uint8_t idx, k=0;
912  uint8_t numParams = 0, elements = 0;
913 
914  if(numElemVirtualAntELev == DPParams->numVirtualAntElev)
915  {
916  /* zero insertion is not required */
917  DPParams->numElevFFTParams = 0U;
918  (void)memset(DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg, 0, sizeof(DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg));
919  }
920  else{
921  uint8_t bitPos[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT] = {0};
922  uint8_t bitPosDiff[MAX_NUM_ELEV_VIRT_ANT - 1U] = {0};
923 
924  for(idx= 0; idx < numElemVirtualAntELev; idx++){
925  if(((zeroMask >> idx) & 0x1U) != 0U)
926  {
927  bitPos[k++] = idx;
928  }
929  }
930 
931  /* difference between two positions */
932  for(k = 1; k < DPParams->numVirtualAntElev; k++)
933  {
934  bitPosDiff[k-1U] = bitPos[k] - bitPos[k-1U];
935  }
936 
937  /* at least one param is required */
938  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[0].srcAddOffset = 0;
939  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[0].dstAddOffset = bitPos[0];
940  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[0].acnt = ((DPParams->numVirtualAntElev - elements) >= 2U) ? (2U - 1U) : (1U - 1U);
941  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[0].dstAidx = bitPosDiff[0];
942  elements += DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[0].acnt + 1U;
943 
944  for(k=1; k < (DPParams->numVirtualAntElev - 1U); k++)
945  {
946  if(bitPosDiff[k] == bitPosDiff[k-1U])
947  {
948  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].acnt++;
949  elements++;
950  }
951  else
952  {
953  numParams++;
954  if(numParams + 1U > DPU_AOAPROCHWA_MAX_ELEVFFTPARAMS_FOR_ZERO_INSERTION)
955  {
956  retVal = DPU_AOAPROCHWA_EEXCEED_ELEVPARAMS;
957  goto exit;
958  }
959 
960  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].srcAddOffset = (DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams-1U].acnt+1U);
961  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].dstAddOffset = bitPos[elements];
962  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].acnt = (DPParams->numVirtualAntElev-elements) >= 2U ? (2U - 1U) : (1U-1U);
963  DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].dstAidx = bitPosDiff[k+1U];
964  elements += DPParams->elevFFTParamCfg[numParams].acnt + 1U;
965  }
966 
967  /* break the lopp if all params are exhausted */
968  if(elements == DPParams->numVirtualAntElev)
969  {
970  break;
971  }
972  }
973  }
974  DPParams->numElevFFTParams = numParams+1U;
975 exit:
976  return (retVal);
977 }

997 static int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_execute
998 (
999  DPM_DPCHandle handle,
1000  DPM_Buffer* ptrResult
1001 )
1002 {
1003  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
1004  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
1005  DPU_RangeProcHWA_OutParams outRangeProc;
1006  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_OutParams outDopplerProc;
1007  DPU_CFARProcHWA_OutParams outCfarProc;
1008  DPU_AoAProcHWA_OutParams outAoaProc;
1009  int32_t retVal;
1010  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *result;
1011  DPC_ObjectDetection_ProcessCallBackCfg *processCallBack;
1012  int32_t i;
1013 
1014  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
1015  DebugP_assert (objDetObj != NULL);
1016  DebugP_assert (ptrResult != NULL);
1017 
1018  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Processing sub-frame %d\n", objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1019 
1020  processCallBack = &objDetObj->processCallBackCfg;
1021 
1022  if (processCallBack->processFrameBeginCallBackFxn != NULL)
1023  {
1024  (*processCallBack->processFrameBeginCallBackFxn)(objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1025  }
1026 
1027  result = &objDetObj->executeResult;
1028 
1029  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
1030 
1031  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &outRangeProc);
1032  if (retVal != 0)
1033  {
1034  goto exit;
1035  }
1036  DebugP_assert(outRangeProc.endOfChirp == true);
1037 
1038  if (processCallBack->processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn != NULL)
1039  {
1040  (*processCallBack->processInterFrameBeginCallBackFxn)(objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1041  }
1042 
1043  objDetObj->stats.interFrameStartTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1044 
1045  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Range Proc Done\n");
1046 
1047  (void)DPC_ObjDet_GenDopplerWindow(&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg);
1048  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_config(subFrmObj->dpuDopplerObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg);
1049  if (retVal != 0)
1050  {
1051  goto exit;
1052  }
1053  retVal = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuDopplerObj, &outDopplerProc);
1054  if (retVal != 0)
1055  {
1056  goto exit;
1057  }
1058 
1059  /* Procedure for range bias measurement and Rx channels gain/phase offset measurement */
1060  if(objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled != 0U)
1061  {
1062  DPC_ObjDet_rangeBiasRxChPhaseMeasure(&subFrmObj->staticCfg,
1063  objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.targetDistance,
1064  objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.searchWinSize,
1065  subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detMatrix.data,
1066  (uint32_t *) subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg.hwRes.radarCube.data,
1067  &objDetObj->compRxChanCfgMeasureOut);
1068  }
1069 
1070  if (subFrmObj->isAoAHWAparamSetOverlappedWithCFAR == true)
1071  {
1072  retVal = DPU_CFARProcHWA_config(subFrmObj->dpuCFARObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.cfarCfg);
1073  if (retVal != 0)
1074  {
1075  goto exit;
1076  }
1077  }
1078 
1079  retVal = DPU_CFARProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuCFARObj, &outCfarProc);
1080  if (retVal != 0)
1081  {
1082  goto exit;
1083  }
1084 
1085  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: number of detected objects after CFAR = %d\n",
1086  outCfarProc.numCfarDetectedPoints);
1087 
1088  if (subFrmObj->isAoAHWAparamSetOverlappedWithCFAR == true)
1089  {
1090  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg outCompRxCfg;
1091 
1092  /* Generate FFT window, note doppler window is used for AoA */
1093  (void)DPC_ObjDet_GenDopplerWindow(&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg);
1094  DPC_ObjDet_GetRxChPhaseComp(&subFrmObj->staticCfg,
1095  &objDetObj->commonCfg.compRxChanCfg, &outCompRxCfg);
1096  subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.dynCfg.compRxChanCfg = &outCompRxCfg;
1097  retVal = DPU_AoAProcHWA_config(subFrmObj->dpuAoAObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg);
1098  if (retVal != 0)
1099  {
1100  goto exit;
1101  }
1102  }
1103 
1104  retVal = DPU_AoAProcHWA_process(subFrmObj->dpuAoAObj,
1105  outCfarProc.numCfarDetectedPoints, &outAoaProc);
1106  if (retVal != 0)
1107  {
1108  goto exit;
1109  }
1110 
1111  /* Set DPM result with measure (bias, phase) and detection info */
1112  result->numObjOut = outAoaProc.numAoADetectedPoints;
1113  result->subFrameIdx = objDetObj->subFrameIndx;
1114  result->objOut = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.res.detObjOut;
1115  result->objOutSideInfo = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.res.detObjOutSideInfo;
1116  result->azimuthStaticHeatMap = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.res.azimuthStaticHeatMap;
1117  result->azimuthStaticHeatMapSize = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.res.azimuthStaticHeatMapSize;
1118  result->radarCube = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.res.radarCube;
1119  result->detMatrix = subFrmObj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.detMatrix;
1120  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled == 1U)
1121  {
1122  result->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = &objDetObj->compRxChanCfgMeasureOut;
1123  }
1124  else
1125  {
1126  result->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = NULL;
1127  }
1128 
1129  /* For rangeProcHwa, interChirpProcessingMargin is not available */
1130  objDetObj->stats.interChirpProcessingMargin = 0;
1131 
1132  objDetObj->stats.interFrameEndTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
1133  result->stats = &objDetObj->stats;
1134 
1135  /* populate DPM_resultBuf - first pointer and size are for results of the
1136  * processing */
1137  ptrResult->ptrBuffer[0] = (uint8_t *)result;
1138  ptrResult->size[0] = sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult);
1139 
1140  /* clear rest of the result */
1141  for (i = 1; i < DPM_MAX_BUFFER; i++)
1142  {
1143  ptrResult->ptrBuffer[i] = NULL;
1144  ptrResult->size[i] = 0;
1145  }
1146 
1147 exit:
1148 
1149  return retVal;
1150 }
1151 
1169 static int32_t DPC_ObjDet_reconfigSubFrame(ObjDetObj *objDetObj, uint8_t subFrameIndx)

1171  int32_t retVal = 0;

1196 
1197  /* Note doppler window will be used for AoA, so maintain the sequence as in
1198  * pre-start config. We need to regenerate the rxChPhaseComp because it was

1200  DPC_ObjDet_GetRxChPhaseComp(&subFrmObj->staticCfg,

1202  subFrmObj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg.dynCfg.compRxChanCfg = &outCompRxCfg;

1228 static int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_start (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
1229 {
1230  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
1231  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
1232  int32_t retVal = 0;
1233 
1234  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
1235  DebugP_assert (objDetObj != NULL);
1236 
1237  objDetObj->stats.frameStartIntCounter = 0;
1238 
1239  /* Start marks consumption of all pre-start configs, reset the flag to check
1240  * if pre-starts were issued only after common config was issued for the next
1241  * time full configuration happens between stop and start */
1242  objDetObj->isCommonCfgReceived = false;
1243 
1244  /* App must issue export of last frame after stop which will switch to sub-frame 0,
1245  * so start should always see sub-frame indx of 0, check */
1246  DebugP_assert(objDetObj->subFrameIndx == 0U);
1247 
1248  /* Pre-start cfgs for sub-frames may have come in any order, so need
1249  * to ensure we reconfig for the current (0) sub-frame before starting */
1250  (void)DPC_ObjDet_reconfigSubFrame(objDetObj, objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
1251 
1252  /* Trigger Range DPU, related to reconfig above */
1253  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
1254 #ifdef OVERLAY_RANGE_HWA_PARAMS
1255  if (DPU_AoAProcHWA_getNumHwaParamSets(subFrmObj->staticCfg.numTxAntennas,
1256  subFrmObj->staticCfg.numVirtualAntElev) >
1257  (16-DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS))
1258  {
1259  DPC_ObjDet_GenRangeWindow(&subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg);
1260  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_config(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj, &subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg);
1261  if (retVal != 0)
1262  {
1263  goto exit;
1264  }
1265  }
1266 #endif
1267  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_control(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj,
1268  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc, NULL, 0);
1269  if(retVal < 0)
1270  {
1271  goto exit;
1272  }
1273 
1274  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Start done\n");
1275 exit:
1276  return(retVal);
1277 }

1454 static int32_t DPC_ObjDet_rangeConfig(DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle dpuHandle,

1456  DPC_ObjectDetection_DynCfg *dynCfg,
1457  EDMA_Handle edmaHandle,
1458  DPIF_RadarCube *radarCube,
1459  MemPoolObj *CoreLocalRamObj,
1460  uint32_t *windowOffset,
1461  uint32_t *CoreLocalRamScratchUsage,
1462  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *cfgSave,

1464 {

1474  (void)memset(cfgSave, 0, sizeof(DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config));
1475 
1476  cfgSave->hwRes.intrObj = &ptrObjDetObj->rangProcIntrObj;
1477 
1478  numRxAntennas = staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
1479 
1480  /* Even though Range DPU supports both modes,
1481  * object detection DPC only supports non-interleaved at present */
1482  DebugP_assert(staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE);
1483 
1484  /* dynamic configuration */
1485  cfgSave->dynCfg.calibDcRangeSigCfg = &dynCfg->calibDcRangeSigCfg;
1486 
1487  /* static configuration */
1488  cfgSave->staticCfg.ADCBufData = staticCfg->ADCBufData;

1490  cfgSave->staticCfg.numRangeBins = staticCfg->numRangeBins;

1493  cfgSave->staticCfg.numVirtualAntennas = staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas;
1494 
1495  if(cfgSave->staticCfg.numRangeBins == cfgSave->staticCfg.numFFTBins){
1496  cfgSave->staticCfg.isChirpDataReal = 0;
1497  }
1498  else if (cfgSave->staticCfg.numRangeBins == cfgSave->staticCfg.numFFTBins / 2U){
1499  cfgSave->staticCfg.isChirpDataReal = 1;
1500  }
1501  else{
1502  retVal = -1;
1503  goto exit;
1504  }
1505  cfgSave->staticCfg.resetDcRangeSigMeanBuffer = 1;
1506  cfgSave->staticCfg.rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift =

2319  DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg,
2320  DPC_ObjectDetection_DynCfg *dynCfg,
2321  EDMA_Handle edmaHandle,
2322  DPIF_RadarCube *radarCube,
2323  DPIF_CFARDetList *cfarRngDopSnrList,
2324  uint32_t cfarRngDopSnrListSize,
2325  MemPoolObj *CoreLocalRamObj,
2326  MemPoolObj *L3RamObj,
2327 
2328  /* doppler window parameters */
2329  uint8_t dopplerWindowSym,
2330  uint32_t dopplerWinSize,
2331  int32_t *dopplerWindow,
2332  uint32_t dopplerWinRamOffset,
2333 
2334  uint8_t cfarParamSetStartIdx,
2335  bool *isAoAHWAparamSetOverlappedWithCFAR,
2336  DPU_AoAProcHWA_Config *cfgSave)
2337 {
2338  int32_t retVal = 0;
2339  DPU_AoAProcHWA_Config aoaCfg;
2340  DPU_AoAProcHWA_HW_Resources *res;
2341  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg outCompRxCfg;
2342  uint32_t i;
2343  uint32_t dmaCh, tcc, param;
2344  uint8_t txAntIdx, rxAntIdx, valIdx, azimElemIdx=0, elevElemIdx = 0;
2345  Element antArr[MAX_NUM_VIRT_ANT] = {0};
2346  Element *elevAntArr = &antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT];
2347  uint32_t zeroInsrtMaskAzim = 0, zeroInsrtMaskElev = 0;
2348 
2349  res = &aoaCfg.res;
2350  (void)memset((void*)&aoaCfg, 0, sizeof(aoaCfg));
2351 
2352  /* Static config */
2353  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numDopplerChirps = staticCfg->numDopplerChirps;
2354  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numDopplerBins = staticCfg->numDopplerBins;
2355  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numRangeBins = staticCfg->numRangeBins;
2356  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numRxAntennas = staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
2357  aoaCfg.staticCfg.dopplerStep = staticCfg->dopplerStep;
2358  aoaCfg.staticCfg.rangeStep = staticCfg->rangeStep;
2359  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numTxAntennas = staticCfg->numTxAntennas;

2361  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numVirtualAnt = staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas;
2362 #else
2363  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numVirtualAntAzim = staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim;
2364  aoaCfg.staticCfg.numVirtualAntElev = staticCfg->numVirtualAntElev;
2365 #endif
2366 
2367  /* antenna geometry definition */
2368  /* antDef is not used in the DPU - and may be incorrect in case of LOP antena. */
2369  DPC_ObjDet_GetAntGeometryDef(staticCfg, &commonCfg->antDef);
2370  aoaCfg.staticCfg.antDef = &staticCfg->antDef;
2371 
2372  /* Copy the antenna spacing */
2373  aoaCfg.staticCfg.antennaSpacing = commonCfg->antennaSpacing;
2374 
2375  /* Get the antenna Geometry Cfg */
2376  for(txAntIdx = 0; txAntIdx < staticCfg->numTxAntennas; txAntIdx++)
2377  {
2378  for(rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2379  {
2380  valIdx = staticCfg->rxAntOrder[rxAntIdx] + staticCfg->txAntOrder[txAntIdx] * SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL;
2381  if(commonCfg->antGeometryCfg[valIdx].row == 0U)
2382  {
2383  /* Elevation Antenna Sample */
2384  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].value = (int)commonCfg->antGeometryCfg[valIdx].col;
2385  antArr[MAX_NUM_AZIM_VIRT_ANT + elevElemIdx].index = (int)elevElemIdx;
2386  elevElemIdx++;

2389  {
2390  /* Azimuth Antenna Sample */
2391  antArr[azimElemIdx].value = (int)commonCfg->antGeometryCfg[valIdx].col;

2394  }
2395  else
2396  {
2397  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL_ANT_PATTERN;
2398  goto exit;
2399  }
2400  }
2401  }

2839  radarCube.data = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolAlloc(L3ramObj, radarCube.dataSize,
2840  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_RADAR_CUBE_DATABUF_BYTE_ALIGNMENT);
2841 
2842  if (radarCube.data == NULL)
2843  {
2844  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM__L3_RAM_RADAR_CUBE;
2845  goto exit;
2846  }
2847  radarCube.datafmt = DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1;
2848 
2849  /* L3 - detection matrix */
2850  detMatrix.dataSize = (uint32_t)staticCfg->numRangeBins * (uint32_t)staticCfg->numDopplerBins * (uint32_t)sizeof(uint16_t);
2851  detMatrix.data = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolAlloc(L3ramObj, detMatrix.dataSize,
2852  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_DET_MATRIX_DATABUF_BYTE_ALIGNMENT);
2853  if (detMatrix.data == NULL)
2854  {
2855  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM__L3_RAM_DET_MATRIX;
2856  goto exit;
2857  }
2858  detMatrix.datafmt = DPIF_DETMATRIX_FORMAT_1;
2859 
2860  /* Core Local - CFAR output list */
2861  cfarRngDopSnrListSize = DPC_OBJDET_MAX_NUM_OBJECTS;
2862 
2863  cfarRngDopSnrList = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolAlloc(CoreLocalRamObj,
2864  cfarRngDopSnrListSize * sizeof(DPIF_CFARDetList),
2865  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_CFAR_DET_LIST_BYTE_ALIGNMENT);
2866  if (cfarRngDopSnrList == NULL)
2867  {
2868  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM__CORE_LOCAL_RAM_CFAR_OUT_DET_LIST;
2869  goto exit;
2870  }
2871 
2872 #ifdef POWER_MEAS
2873 
2874 #ifdef SOC_AWR294X
2875  gMmwDssMCB.powerMeas.dspLoading = obj->staticCfg.isDspLoading;
2876  gMmwDssMCB.powerMeas.dspTimeToLoad = obj->staticCfg.dspTimeToLoad;
2877  gMmwDssMCB.powerMeas.dspClkReduce = obj->staticCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc;
2878 #endif
2879 
2880 #ifdef SOC_AWR2X44P
2881  /* For DSP Sleep Time Computation */
2882  gMmwDssMCB.framePeriod = obj->staticCfg.framePeriod;
2883 #endif
2884 
2885 #endif
2886 
2887  /* Remember pool position */
2888  CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolGet(CoreLocalRamObj);
2889 
2890 #ifdef POWER_MEAS
2891  if(obj->staticCfg.isHwaDynamicClkGate != 0U)
2892  {
2893  CSL_FINSR(ctrlBaseAddr->HWA_ENABLE,
2894  HWA_ENABLE_HWA_DYN_CLK_EN_END,
2895  HWA_ENABLE_HWA_DYN_CLK_EN_START,
2896  (bool)(obj->staticCfg.isHwaDynamicClkGate));
2897  }
2898 #endif
2899 
2900  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_rangeConfig(obj->dpuRangeObj, &obj->staticCfg, &obj->dynCfg,
2901  edmaHandle[0],
2902  &radarCube, CoreLocalRamObj, &hwaWindowOffset,
2903  &rangeCoreLocalRamScratchUsage, &obj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg,
2904  ptrObjDetObj);
2905  if (retVal != 0)
2906  {
2907  goto exit;
2908  }
2909 
2910  /* Rewind to the scratch beginning */
2911  DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolSet(CoreLocalRamObj, CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr);
2912 
2913  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_CFARconfig(obj->dpuCFARObj, &obj->staticCfg,
2914  obj->log2NumDopplerBins, &obj->dynCfg,
2915  edmaHandle[0],
2916  &detMatrix,
2917  cfarRngDopSnrList,
2918  cfarRngDopSnrListSize,
2919  CoreLocalRamObj,
2920  &hwaMemBankAddr[0],
2921  hwaMemBankSize,
2922  commonCfg->compRxChanCfg.rangeBias,
2923  &cfarCoreLocalRamScratchUsage,
2924  &obj->dpuCfg.cfarCfg);
2925  if (retVal != 0)
2926  {
2927  goto exit;
2928  }
2929 
2930  /* Rewind to the scratch beginning */
2931  DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolSet(CoreLocalRamObj, CoreLocalScratchStartPoolAddr);
2932 
2933  /* Note doppler will generate window (that will be used by AoA next)
2934  * in core local scratch memory, so scratch should not be reset after this point
2935  * (AoA itself does not need scratch) */
2936  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_dopplerConfig(obj->dpuDopplerObj, &obj->staticCfg,
2937  obj->log2NumDopplerBins, &obj->dynCfg,
2938  edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_DOPPLERPROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
2939  &radarCube, &detMatrix, CoreLocalRamObj, &hwaWindowOffset,
2940  &dopplerCoreLocalRamScratchUsage, &obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg,
2941  ptrObjDetObj);
2942  if (retVal != 0)
2943  {
2944  goto exit;
2945  }
2946 
2947  /* Presently AoA does not use Core Local scratch because window is fed from doppler above
2948  * and all its allocation is persistent within sub-frame processing. Given also that AoA
2949  * is the last module to be called, its DPIF type buffers can be overlaid with
2950  * scratch buffers used in previous modules in the processing chain. So unlike radarCube
2951  * and detMatrix, the DPIF buffers of AoA don't need to be allocated up-front like
2952  * radarCube and detMatrix. There are also some debug buffers in AoA that are tied
2953  * to the DPIF which are conveniently localized in this function.
2954  * Given we are feeding doppler window generated in the dopplerConfig call above,
2955  * we cannot reset the Core Local RAM to the scratchStartPoolAddr.
2956  */
2957  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_AoAconfig(obj->dpuAoAObj,
2958  commonCfg,
2959  &obj->staticCfg,
2960  &obj->dynCfg,
2961  edmaHandle[DPC_OBJDET_DPU_AOA_PROC_EDMA_INST_ID],
2962  &radarCube,
2963  cfarRngDopSnrList, cfarRngDopSnrListSize,
2964  CoreLocalRamObj,
2965  L3ramObj,
2966  obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.hwaCfg.winSym,
2967  obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.hwaCfg.windowSize,
2968  obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.hwaCfg.window,
2969  obj->dpuCfg.dopplerCfg.hwRes.hwaCfg.winRamOffset,
2970  (uint8_t)DPC_OBJDET_DPU_CFAR_PROC_PARAMSET_START_IDX(staticCfg->numTxAntennas),
2971  &obj->isAoAHWAparamSetOverlappedWithCFAR,
2972  &obj->dpuCfg.aoaCfg);
2973 
2974  if (retVal != 0)
2975  {
2976  goto exit;
2977  }
2978 
2979  /* Report RAM usage */
2980  *CoreLocalRamUsage = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolGetMaxUsage(CoreLocalRamObj);
2981  *L3RamUsage = DPC_ObjDet_MemPoolGetMaxUsage(L3ramObj);
2982 
2983 exit:
2984  return retVal;
2985 }

3005 static int32_t DPC_ObjectDetection_ioctl
3006 (
3007  DPM_DPCHandle handle,
3008  uint32_t cmd,
3009  void* arg,
3010  uint32_t argLen
3011 )
3012 {
3013  ObjDetObj *objDetObj;
3014  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
3015  int32_t retVal = 0;
3016 
3017  /* Get the DSS MCB: */
3018  objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
3019  DebugP_assert(objDetObj != NULL);
3020 
3021  /* Process the commands. Process non sub-frame specific ones first
3022  * so the sub-frame specific ones can share some code. */
3023  if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__TRIGGER_FRAME)
3024  {
3025  DPC_ObjectDetection_frameStart(handle);
3026  }
3027  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG)
3028  {
3029  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg *cfg;
3030  uint32_t indx;
3031 
3032  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg));
3033 
3034  cfg = (DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg*)arg;
3035 
3036  /* Free all buffers that were allocated from system (MemoryP) heap.
3037  * Note we cannot free buffers during allocation time
3038  * for new config during the pre-start config processing because the heap is not capable
3039  * of defragmentation. This means pre-start common config must precede
3040  * all pre-start configs. */
3041  for(indx = 0; indx < objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames; indx++)
3042  {
3043  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[indx];
3044 
3045  if (subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg.hwRes.dcRangeSigMean != NULL)
3046  {
3047  HeapP_free(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg.hwRes.dcRangeSigMean);
3048  subFrmObj->dpuCfg.rangeCfg.hwRes.dcRangeSigMean = NULL;
3049  }
3050  }
3051 
3052  objDetObj->commonCfg = *cfg;
3053  objDetObj->isCommonCfgReceived = true;
3054 
3055  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Pre-start Common Config IOCTL processed\n");
3056  }
3057  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_MEASURE_RANGE_BIAS_AND_RX_CHAN_PHASE)
3058  {
3059  DPC_ObjectDetection_MeasureRxChannelBiasCfg *cfg;
3060 
3061  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_MeasureRxChannelBiasCfg));
3062 
3063  cfg = (DPC_ObjectDetection_MeasureRxChannelBiasCfg*)arg;
3064 
3065  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_Config_MeasureRxChannelBiasCfg(objDetObj, cfg);
3066  if (retVal != 0)
3067  {
3068  goto exit;
3069  }
3070  }
3071  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_COMP_RANGE_BIAS_AND_RX_CHAN_PHASE)
3072  {
3073  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *inpCfg;
3074  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg outCfg;
3075  uint32_t i;
3076 
3077  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg));
3078 
3079  inpCfg = (DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg*)arg;
3080 
3081  for(i = 0; i < objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames; i++)
3082  {
3083  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[i];
3084 
3085  DPC_ObjDet_GetRxChPhaseComp(&subFrmObj->staticCfg, inpCfg, &outCfg);
3086 
3087  retVal = DPU_AoAProcHWA_control(subFrmObj->dpuAoAObj,
3088  DPU_AoAProcHWA_Cmd_CompRxChannelBiasCfg,
3089  &outCfg,
3090  sizeof(DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg));
3091  if (retVal != 0)
3092  {
3093  goto exit;
3094  }
3095  }
3096 
3097  /* save into object */
3098  objDetObj->commonCfg.compRxChanCfg = *inpCfg;
3099  }
3100  else if (cmd == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_EXECUTE_RESULT_EXPORTED)
3101  {
3102  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo *inp;
3103  volatile uint32_t startTime;
3104 
3105  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3106 
3107  DebugP_assert(argLen == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo));
3108 
3109  inp = (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo *)arg;
3110 
3111  /* input sub-frame index must match current sub-frame index */
3112  DebugP_assert(inp->subFrameIdx == objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
3113 
3114  /* Reconfigure all DPUs resources for next sub-frame as all HWA and EDMA
3115  * resources overlap across sub-frames */
3116  if (objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames > 1U)
3117  {
3118  /* Next sub-frame */
3119  objDetObj->subFrameIndx++;
3120  if (objDetObj->subFrameIndx == objDetObj->commonCfg.numSubFrames)
3121  {
3122  objDetObj->subFrameIndx = 0;
3123  }
3124 
3125  (void)DPC_ObjDet_reconfigSubFrame(objDetObj, objDetObj->subFrameIndx);
3126  }
3127 
3128  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[objDetObj->subFrameIndx];
3129 
3130 #ifdef OVERLAY_RANGE_HWA_PARAMS
3131  if(DPU_AoAProcHWA_getNumHwaParamSets(subFrmObj->staticCfg.numTxAntennas,
3132  subFrmObj->staticCfg.numVirtualAntElev) >

3137  if (retVal != 0)
3138  {
3139  goto exit;
3140  }
3141  }
3142 #endif
3143  /* Trigger Range DPU */
3144  retVal = DPU_RangeProcHWA_control(subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj,
3145  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc, NULL, 0);

3148  goto exit;
3149  }

3151  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Range Proc Triggered in export IOCTL\n");
3152 
3153  objDetObj->stats.subFramePreparationCycles =
3154  CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime;
3155 
3156  /* mark end of processing of the frame/sub-frame by the DPC and the app */
3157  objDetObj->interSubFrameProcToken--;
3158 
3159 #ifdef POWER_MEAS
3160  (void)DPC_ObjectDetection_HwaDspGate(handle);
3161 #endif
3162 
3163  }
3164  else
3165  {
3166  uint8_t subFrameNum;

3423  retVal = DPC_ObjDet_preStartConfig(subFrmObj,
3424  &objDetObj->commonCfg, &cfg->staticCfg, &cfg->dynCfg,
3425  &objDetObj->edmaHandle[0],
3426  &objDetObj->L3RamObj,
3427  &objDetObj->CoreLocalRamObj,
3428  &objDetObj->hwaMemBankAddr[0],
3429  objDetObj->hwaMemBankSize,
3430  &memUsage->L3RamUsage,
3431  &memUsage->CoreLocalRamUsage,
3432  objDetObj);
3433  if (retVal != 0)
3434  {
3435  goto exit;
3436  }
3437 
3438  /* Get system heap size after preStart configuration */
3439  HeapP_getHeapStats(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, &statsEnd);
3440 
3441  /* Populate system heap usage */
3442  memUsage->SystemHeapTotal = OBJECTDETECTION_HEAP_MEM_SIZE;
3443  memUsage->SystemHeapUsed = OBJECTDETECTION_HEAP_MEM_SIZE - statsEnd.availableHeapSpaceInBytes;
3444  memUsage->SystemHeapDPCUsed = statsStart.availableHeapSpaceInBytes - statsEnd.availableHeapSpaceInBytes;
3445 
3446  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: Pre-start Config IOCTL processed (subFrameIndx = %d)\n", subFrameNum);
3447  break;
3448  }
3449 
3450  default:
3451  {
3452  /* Error: This is an unsupported command */
3453  retVal = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL__COMMAND;
3454  break;
3455  }
3456  }
3457  }
3458 
3459 exit:
3460  return retVal;
3461 }

3487 static DPM_DPCHandle DPC_ObjectDetection_init
3488 (
3489  DPM_Handle dpmHandle,
3490  DPM_InitCfg* ptrInitCfg,
3491  int32_t* errCode
3492 )
3493 {
3494  uint8_t i;
3495  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = NULL;
3496  SubFrameObj *subFrmObj;
3497  DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams *dpcInitParams;
3498  DPU_RangeProcHWA_InitParams rangeInitParams;
3499  DPU_AoAProcHWA_InitParams aoaInitParams;
3500  DPU_CFARProcHWA_InitParams cfarInitParams;
3501  DPU_DopplerProcHWA_InitParams dopplerInitParams;
3502  HWA_MemInfo hwaMemInfo;
3503 
3504  *errCode = 0;
3505 
3506  if ((ptrInitCfg == NULL) || (ptrInitCfg->arg == NULL))
3507  {
3508  *errCode = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL;
3509  goto exit;
3510  }
3511 
3512  if (ptrInitCfg->argSize != sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams))
3513  {
3514  *errCode = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_EINVAL__INIT_CFG_ARGSIZE;
3515  goto exit;
3516  }
3517 
3518  /* create heap for RangeProc Hwa object. */
3519  HeapP_construct(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, gObjectDetectionHeapMem, OBJECTDETECTION_HEAP_MEM_SIZE);
3520 
3521  dpcInitParams = (DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams *) ptrInitCfg->arg;
3522 
3523  objDetObj = HeapP_alloc(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, sizeof(ObjDetObj));
3524 
3525 #ifdef DBG_DPC_OBJDET
3526  gObjDetObj = objDetObj;
3527 #endif
3528 
3529  DebugP_logInfo("ObjDet DPC: objDetObj address = %d\n", (uint32_t) objDetObj);
3530 
3531  if(objDetObj == NULL)
3532  {
3533  *errCode = DPC_OBJECTDETECTION_ENOMEM;
3534  goto exit;
3535  }
3536 
3537  /* Initialize memory */
3538  (void)memset((void *)objDetObj, 0, sizeof(ObjDetObj));
3539 
3540  /* Copy over the DPM configuration: */
3541  (void)memcpy ((void*)&objDetObj->dpmInitCfg, (void*)ptrInitCfg, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
3542 
3543  objDetObj->dpmHandle = dpmHandle;
3544  objDetObj->L3RamObj.cfg = dpcInitParams->L3ramCfg;
3545  objDetObj->CoreLocalRamObj.cfg = dpcInitParams->CoreLocalRamCfg;
3546 
3547  for(i = 0; i < (uint8_t)EDMA_NUM_CC; i++)
3548  {
3549  objDetObj->edmaHandle[i] = dpcInitParams->edmaHandle[i];
3550  }
3551 
3552  objDetObj->processCallBackCfg = dpcInitParams->processCallBackCfg;
3553 
3554  /* Set HWA bank memory address */
3555  *errCode = HWA_getHWAMemInfo(dpcInitParams->hwaHandle, &hwaMemInfo);
3556  if (*errCode != 0)
3557  {
3558  goto exit;
3559  }
3560 
3561  objDetObj->hwaMemBankSize = hwaMemInfo.bankSize;
3562 
3563  for (i = 0; i < hwaMemInfo.numBanks; i++)
3564  {
3565  objDetObj->hwaMemBankAddr[i] = hwaMemInfo.baseAddress + (uint32_t)i * (uint32_t)hwaMemInfo.bankSize;
3566  }
3567 
3568  rangeInitParams.hwaHandle = dpcInitParams->hwaHandle;
3569  aoaInitParams.hwaHandle = dpcInitParams->hwaHandle;
3570  cfarInitParams.hwaHandle = dpcInitParams->hwaHandle;
3571  dopplerInitParams.hwaHandle = dpcInitParams->hwaHandle;
3572 
3573  for(i = 0; i < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES; i++)
3574  {
3575  subFrmObj = &objDetObj->subFrameObj[i];
3576 
3577  subFrmObj->dpuRangeObj = DPU_RangeProcHWA_init(&rangeInitParams, i, errCode);
3578 
3579  if (*errCode != 0)
3580  {
3581  goto exit;
3582  }
3583 
3584  subFrmObj->dpuCFARObj = DPU_CFARProcHWA_init(&cfarInitParams, i, errCode);
3585 
3586  if (*errCode != 0)
3587  {
3588  goto exit;
3589  }
3590 
3591  subFrmObj->dpuDopplerObj = DPU_DopplerProcHWA_init(&dopplerInitParams, i, errCode);
3592 
3593  if (*errCode != 0)
3594  {
3595  goto exit;
3596  }
3597 
3598  subFrmObj->dpuAoAObj = DPU_AoAProcHWA_init(&aoaInitParams, i, errCode);
3599 
3600  if (*errCode != 0)
3601  {
3602  goto exit;
3603  }
3604  }
3605 
3606 exit:
3607 
3608  if(*errCode != 0)
3609  {
3610  if(objDetObj != NULL)
3611  {
3612  HeapP_free(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, objDetObj);
3613  HeapP_destruct(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj);
3614  objDetObj = NULL;
3615  }
3616  }
3617 
3618  return ((DPM_DPCHandle)objDetObj);
3619 }

3677  if (retVal != 0)
3678  {
3679  goto exit;
3680  }
3681  }
3682 
3683  HeapP_free(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj, handle);
3684  HeapP_destruct(&gObjectDetectionHeapObj);
3685 exit:
3686 
3687  return (retVal);
3688 }

3705 static inline void DPC_ObjectDetection_HwaDspGate (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
3706 {
3707  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
3708  CSL_dss_rcmRegs *ptrDssRcmRegs = (CSL_dss_rcmRegs *)CSL_DSS_RCM_U_BASE;
3709 
3710  /* HWA Clock gate or Power Gate */
3711  if (objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.hwaStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CG_ENABLE)
3712  {
3713  /* Gate HWA Peripheral Clock */
3714  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_CLK_GATE = 0x7;
3715  }
3716 
3717 #ifdef SOC_AWR2X44P
3718  /* DSP Power Gate/ Underclock */
3719  /* Check remaining idle time and Power Gate DSP */
3720  uint32_t curTime = ((CycleCounterP_getCount32() - gMmwDssMCB.frameStartTimeStamp)/DSP_CLOCK_MHZ); //In micro seconds
3721  float temp = (float)gMmwDssMCB.framePeriod * 1000.0f; // In milliseconds
3722  uint32_t remTime = (uint32_t)temp - curTime; // In milliseconds
3723  remTime *= 1000U; // In Nanoseconds
3724 
3725  if(objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_DSS_UC_ENABLE)
3726  {
3727  /* Switch DSP Clock to XTAL */
3728  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_DSP_CLK_SRC_SEL = DPC_OBJDET_DSP_CLK_SRC_XTAL;
3729  }
3730  else if((remTime > contextSave.minTime) && (objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_DSS_PG_ENABLE))
3731  {
3732  contextSave.altPc = 0x12345678;
3733  }
3734 #endif
3735 
3736 #ifdef SOC_AWR294X
3737  if(objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.hwaStateAfterFrameProc == 1)
3738  {
3739 
3740  /* HWA - Power gating */
3741  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_CLK_GATE = 0x7;
3742  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_PD_CTRL = 0x77777;
3743  ptrDssRcmRegs->HW_SPARE_RW0 = 0x70000;
3744  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_PD_CTRL = 0x77707;
3745  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_PD_CTRL = 0x77007;
3746  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_PD_CTRL = 0x70007;
3747  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_PD_CTRL = 0x00007;
3748  }
3749 #endif
3750 
3751 }
3752 
3767 static inline void DPC_ObjectDetection_HwaDspUngate (DPM_DPCHandle handle)
3768 {
3769  ObjDetObj *objDetObj = (ObjDetObj *) handle;
3770  CSL_dss_rcmRegs *ptrDssRcmRegs = (CSL_dss_rcmRegs *)CSL_DSS_RCM_U_BASE;
3771 
3772  #if defined SOC_AWR2X44P
3773  /* For DSP Sleep time calculation */
3774  gMmwDssMCB.frameStartTimeStamp = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3775  #elif defined SOC_AWR294X
3776  SemaphoreP_post(&gMmwDssMCB.dspLoadSemaphore);
3777  gMmwDssMCB.powerMeas.frameStartTimeStamp = ClockP_getTimeUsec();
3778  #endif
3779 
3780  if(objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.dspStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_DSS_UC_ENABLE)
3781  {
3782  /* Switch back DSP CLock source */
3783  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_DSP_CLK_SRC_SEL = DPC_OBJDET_DSP_CLK_SRC_DSP_PLL_MUX;
3784  }
3785  if(objDetObj->subFrameObj[0].staticCfg.hwaStateAfterFrameProc == DPC_OBJDET_HWA_CG_ENABLE)
3786  {
3787  /* Ungate HWA Peripheral Clock */
3788  ptrDssRcmRegs->DSS_HWA_CLK_GATE = 0x0;
3789  }
3790 
3791 }
